title: Easy 30min (amber)
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 30min at 135-148bpm, flat, conversational. Hard ceiling 148: walk 1min if it goes over. No strides.
GYM: none.
FUEL: normal.
STOP RULE: heavy legs, HR over 150 on flat after walking, or any illness sign = walk home and rest.
WHY: HRV under 55 for 3 days (47 today) and the last 2 easy runs averaged 156-158bpm.
